description: Paid endpoint ($0.005): about-hourly open-interest history (coins, USD, mark, hourly funding) for one Hyperliquid main-dex perp, from cryptofeed402's own snapshots (8-day retention; Hyperliquid has no public OI history). hours 1-192, default 24. HIP-3 symbols, bad params or missing history return an error and no charge. Returns the x402 payment requirements and URL. Free sample response: https://cryptofeed402.site/samples/oi-history

symbol.description: Hyperliquid main-dex perp ticker, e.g. BTC

name: get_oi_history
title: Open-interest history (paid, x402) — $0.005

x402.behavior: Tool returns x402 payment requirements + URL; caller pays over HTTP with own wallet. Charged only on HTTP 200.
